pkgmetadata.longdescription: Claude desktop app (Chat, Cowork, Claude Code; Linux beta), repackaged from Anthropic's official .deb in its signed apt repository. Unofficial Gentoo packaging; not affiliated with Anthropic. Updates arrive through Portage, not the app.

use.flag: Pull in QEMU, UEFI firmware and virtiofsd, which Cowork needs to run its virtual machine (needs /dev/kvm and kvm group membership)
